_comment: Hand-authored snapshot for https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/. Each entry describes ONLY the attributes the live page actually has — no fictional ARIA roles or names. The locator picker will choose getByPlaceholder / getByRole / locator(#id) based on what's present.
title: Test Login | Practice Test Automation

accessibilityTree._note: Page heading — has visible text but no aria-label
accessibilityTree.name: Test login

accessibilityTree._note: Username input — no label, no placeholder, no aria-label. Only id='username'. Picker → locator('#username').
Password input — same shape as username.
Submit button — visible text 'Submit' becomes its accessible name. Picker → getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).
accessibilityTree.name: Submit

accessibilityTree._note: Error div — no role='alert', no aria-label. Only an id='error'. Picker must fall to css selector: locator('#error').
Success page — h1 with text 'Logged In Successfully'. Picker → getByRole('heading', { name: '...' }).
accessibilityTree.name: Logged In Successfully

accessibilityTree._note: Welcome paragraph on success page. No role; only visible text. Picker → getByText('Congratulations...').
accessibilityTree.text: Congratulations student. You successfully logged in!

accessibilityTree._note: Logout link on success page — anchor with text 'Log out'. Picker → getByRole('link', { name: 'Log out' }).
accessibilityTree.name: Log out
